text:
molly_marketing: Quick sync re: Mariner Health case study. We need final interview time, the quote we'll use on the landing page, and a legal sign-off timeline. Target publish = 2 weeks after webinar.

diego_cs: Customer available next week Tue/Thu afternoon PT. Prefer Tue 2pm PT.

molly_marketing: Tue 2pm PT works for our producer. Can you confirm with Mariner and add calendar invite? Include recording + slide deck ask.

diego_cs: Pinged them — waiting on confirmation. I asked for 45 min interview, recording + headshot. Said they'll confirm by EOD.

sam_pm: Heads-up: we want a 1-sentence hero quote + 2 supporting bullets from the interview. Can we parse candidates during call?

molly_marketing: Yes. I'll bring the quote prompts. Example prompts: "How has Redwood changed your engineering throughput?" and "What specifically improved after moving to Dedicated?"

helen_legal: On legal — we need a signed customer release and approval on any quoted material. Please route the draft release to the customer and cc legal@redwood. We need approval before public publish.

molly_marketing: Understood. Diego, can you send the release draft once the interview time is booked?

diego_cs: Yep. I'll attach the release to the invite and ask them to sign ahead of time.

molly_marketing: Also: embargo window — prefer holding press for 48 hours post-webinar. Is that OK?

sam_pm: Fine from product side. We'll make sure feature notation is accurate. Kai, any last-minute product clarifications?

kai_prod: Just one: if they reference latency numbers, use the benchmark delta metric from the internal doc (2.8x faster p99) — i'll paste the snippet into the thread.

molly_marketing: Please paste the exact phrasing, Kai, so legal can review.

kai_prod: "Redwood Dedicated reduced inference p99 latency by 2.8x on Mariner's end-to-end pipeline, enabling faster real-time recommendations."

helen_legal: That phrasing is ok in principle but we need citations/bench logs attached. Also suggest: replace "reduced" with "measured" and remove vendor-relative wording. Draft suggestion: "In our tests, Redwood Dedicated measured a 2.8x improvement in end-to-end inference p99 latency for Mariner's recommendation pipeline."

molly_marketing: Good tweak. I'll prepare two quote variants (hero + alt) using Helen's language.

diego_cs: Mariner confirmed Tue 2pm PT. Invite sent to: sara@marinerhealth.com, kevin@marinerhealth.com. Release doc attached.

molly_marketing: Great — I'll slot a producer, recorder, and pre-call brief 15 min before.

ops-bot: Reminder: When interview assets are uploaded, tag with #mariner-case and set retention 90d.

molly_marketing: Next steps checklist: 1) Producer pre-call (molly) 2) Release signed (diego) 3) Legal approval of quote phrasing (helen) 4) Final quote selected and copy locked (molly/sam) 5) Asset upload + embargo set (molly) 6) Publish schedule aligned with webinar (sam).

helen_legal: I'll review the finalized quote after the transcript is ready. Please ping me in-thread when it's uploaded.

molly_marketing: Will do. If anyone wants to propose alternate hero quote text now, drop it here. Otherwise I'll post the two variants after the call. :thumbsup:

diego_cs: Thanks team — will follow up if customer asks for changes.

molly_marketing: Thanks all, closing loop once release + quote are locked.
